routing_warnings.description: The reported Solara Cove 3 color-placement error specifies a black border with a mustard interior and therefore belongs to the mustard block-color pareo.
The client changes the dimensions for the pareo artwork generally rather than the terracotta design's independent color or border behavior.
The freelancer's delivery of rescaled 133 × 173 cm files is implementation evidence for the dimensions and seam-allowance Requirement.
The broad final-delivery statement supports the print-ready output Requirement but does not explicitly identify the mustard pareo strongly enough for another target-specific implementation claim.
The requested resize to 130 by 170 cm, or 133 by 173 cm with seam allowance, changes the shared artwork-dimensions Requirement.
The completed rescaling claim belongs to the shared artwork-dimensions Requirement rather than specifically to the mustard pareo design.
The Technical Sheet retaining obsolete dimensions is a final-output documentation inconsistency rather than evidence that the rescaled artwork files themselves have incorrect geometry.
The requested reversal to a black border with mustard inside concerns the visual composition of the mustard block-color pareo rather than technical color encoding.
The obsolete measurements remaining on the Technical Sheet concern the resized artwork dimensions, not the print-color specification.
The rescaling claim and obsolete measurements in the Technical Sheet concern the artwork geometry specification rather than file format, resolution, or general print readiness.
